model: GNU BF524 with both documented writeback patches; no hardware timing
limitations: Complete constructor only; no caller, dispatcher, allocator, activation, release or render execution.
Eight table words and globals are explicit; no default value or commercial mode identity is inferred.
Large table words and raw 32-bit notes/velocities are stress inputs, not asserted normal musical ranges.
Shared images are raw preserved stress data, not initialized voice state. No L1 execution, pitch-buffer producer or cadence is reconstructed.
Original firmware, instructions, disassembly and ELF remain private.

rea.scope: Private static disassembly of the complete 68-byte constructor. No L1 decryption or numeric validation by REA.

validation.windows: New comparator compiled for Windows MSVC ABI and passed under Wine. Native Windows/macOS CI pending.
validation.sanitizers: New comparator passed ASan+UBSan; LeakSanitizer disabled for sandbox ptrace limitation.
validation.reproduction_scope: Expanded numeric input and all original output agree byte for byte in three fresh private directories.
validation.existing_original_oracle: verify-voice246-poly-release.py reproduced all existing input/output fixtures without --record using this rebuilt toolchain.
validation.toolchain_setup: Rebuilt from verified GNU archives with setup-blackfin.py --halfword-writeback; five D-register probes stock/patched and three halfword probes passed.
validation.adapter_guards: Invalid table index rejects before writes when needed; discriminator exactly 1 bypasses index validation.
validation.integration: No activation, release, MIDI dispatcher, allocator, audio render, plugin or installer changes.
validation.timing: No hardware, DAW/ASIO, latency or dropout measurements.
